notes: Two construct chains with an articled rectum rendered anarthrously (`חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב` twice); both give the single written *the* to the article morpheme and the *of* to the rectum under rules 29 and 19.
`שָׁמוֹר` is an independent imperatival infinitive absolute, not a cognate one beside a finite verb, so rule 56 does not reach it and the bare *Observe* is its whole rendering.
`לָיְלָה` takes the supplied *by* under rule 33 as an adverbial accusative of time.
